purpose: Review official Sterling Heights and Macomb County parcel channels and qualify bounded anonymous parcel geometry evidence.
assessment: First-party Sterling Heights city GIS and Macomb County GIS parcel resources were identified. The city ArcGIS REST routes advertise parcel layers, but the bounded anonymous REST metadata request timed out from this environment; no parcel geometry or native ID was verified or retained.
registryAssessment: A local public parcel-map custodian is evidenced by the City of Sterling Heights GIS map gallery and city-hosted ArcGIS services. Macomb County separately documents its GIS mapping workgroup and public GIS Parcel Explorer. These are local mapping/parcel resources, not evidence of titleholder or owner data access.
